aiRecommendations.problem: Image elements are missing [alt] text description values
aiRecommendations.whyItMatters: Screen readers rely on alt descriptions to understand context and visual hierarchy.
aiRecommendations.howToFix: Ensure all images have a descriptive alt tag, or alt="" if decorative.

aiRecommendations.whyItMatters: A missing CSP makes the web page vulnerable to cross-site scripting (XSS) attacks.
aiRecommendations.howToFix: Add Content-Security-Policy response headers specifying trusted scripts, styles, and iframe origins.

aiRecommendations.problem: Heading hierarchy is non-optimal or contains multiple H1 elements
aiRecommendations.whyItMatters: Search engines use header hierarchies to parse core topics and establish content structures.
aiRecommendations.howToFix: Restrict H1 tag to a single instance for the document title. Use H2 and H3 for subheaders.
